title: The McKay correspondence and local heights for wild-by-tame split metacyclic groups
summary: We study the McKay correspondence for the representations of certain wild-by-tame split metacyclic groups whose order is divisible by the characteristic of the base field. We calculate the stringy motive of the quotient variety and find a formula for its stringy Euler number. As a consequence, we prove that a crepant resolution of the quotient variety (provided one exists) does not in general have Euler characteristic equal to the number of conjugacy classes in $G$, in contrast to the classical case.
